Authoritative recovery persists and publishes atomically; acceptance/lost replies do not auto-clear. beforeDispatch associates exact public DSH request identity; no Native receipt is fabricated.

Subscriber regression fails on reviewed source (plain/no marker), then passes with a reentrant public setDraft refused before accepted recovery. Actual Chromium refresh records both sending phases, marker, original order and editBlocked=true; existing independent newer-draft recovery cases pass.

One authority helper checks provider identity, exact retained binding and all scope fields for persistence/checkpoint/dispatch/hydration/recovery. Revision, marker identity, signal and frozen-state policies remain specific to each operation. No Connection retry or native reconciliation policy change.
